commit.message:
desktop: occlusion standby + skip render while minimized

Stop driving the video swapchain when the window is not visible (per DXGI
guidance) to cut churn across focus/occlusion transitions, while investigating
the alt-tab monitor re-sync on the VRR/DSC display.

- render(): on Present -> DXGI_STATUS_OCCLUDED, enter standby; while in standby
  only poll with DXGI_PRESENT_TEST (no draw/present/commit), resume when visible.
- WM_TIMER: skip render entirely while IsIconic (minimized).
- WM_ACTIVATE + standby enter/leave logged — instrumentation to correlate focus
  changes with the re-sync on the affected hardware.
- State: add standby: Cell<bool>.

Phase 2 (suppress idle presents) deferred: needs an mpv render-update signal the
compositor does not expose. Phase 3 (allow-tearing) dropped: not applicable to a
DWM-composited CreateSwapChainForComposition swapchain.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

DIAGNOSTIC (do not merge): freeze presentation in render()

Action 1 of the alt-tab monitor re-sync investigation. Gates Present/Commit
behind FREEZE_PRESENTATION=true so the render loop issues no presentation while
the build runs (on-screen frame frozen). Isolates whether the present loop
drives the flash: if the re-sync persists with zero presents, the present loop
is not the cause and the transition is DWM/driver-level. Revert after observation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

desktop: gate presentation on focus (Action 2; supersedes freeze diagnostic)

Revert the freeze-presentation diagnostic (a null result there was dubious: with
no video there is no trigger). Instead present only while the window is focused;
while defocused, render() issues no Present/Commit and the frame freezes until
refocus, with normal playback when focused.

Tests whether presenting through a focus change drives the alt-tab monitor
re-sync, while keeping video playing so the triggering conditions still exist.

- State: add focused: Cell<bool> (init true).
- render(): early-return when not focused.
- WM_ACTIVATE: set focused from activation state.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

desktop: revert focus-gating; restore standby-only presentation

Focus-gating (c02e564) did not resolve the alt-tab monitor re-sync — the flash
was observed with no presents during defocus — and it freezes defocused video,
which is undesirable to ship. Restore the standby-only render loop (the spec-
grounded occlusion handling) plus the WM_ACTIVATE focus-transition logging.

Determination: the re-sync is DWM's focus-driven switch of the window swapchain
between Composed (unfocused) and Independent-Flip/MPO direct-scanout (focused),
which re-trains the VRR/DSC link. DWM owns that decision; the composition-
swapchain API exposes no supported "always composed" control. Documented
mitigations are system-side (DWM MPO disable / NVCP G-Sync fullscreen-only) and
are out of scope. Not fixable in-app without a large, unverifiable rearchitecture
off the DWM-composited flip-swapchain model.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

desktop: force video plane to Composed via sub-unity opacity (flash candidate)

Apply a DComp opacity effect (0.99) to the video visual so DWM must
alpha-blend it, making the swapchain ineligible for the independent-flip /
MPO scanout path. PresentMon recorded the video swapchain churning between
"Composed: Flip" and "Hardware Composed: Independent Flip" across focus
edges; that present-mode promotion/demotion is the candidate trigger for the
VRR+DSC display-link re-train ("flash") on alt-tab. Pinning the plane to
Composed removes the churn.

Candidate fix under objective grading (PresentMon must show zero Independent
Flip frames even when focused). 1% transparency is a test artifact to be
refined to a no-op filter effect if the mechanism is confirmed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs: record force-composed video-plane decision (ADR-0002 + shell contract)

Document the alt-tab monitor flash root cause (DWM promoting the video
swapchain to independent-flip/MPO on focus edges, re-training the DSC/VRR
link) and the fix (sub-unity opacity pins the plane to DWM composition).
Captures the SDR coupling caveat (forcing composition defeats HDR
passthrough) and the PresentMon grading method.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
